preconditions.description: The number of planks n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(h) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in h)
preconditions.description: The list h contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (l, r) satisfies 1 <= l <= r <= n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == count_matching(h, queries[i][0], queries[i][1]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th output line is the count of distinct pieces (l2, r2) that match the query piece (l1, r1), where matching requires: (1) non-intersection (r2 < l1 or r2 > r1), (2) equal width (r2 - l2 == r1 - l1), and (3) for all k in [0, width-1], h[l1+k-1] + h[l2+k-1] == h[l1-1] + h[l2-1].
